fields.account:
Show who's here on mobile via a slide-in drawer

The mobile media query hid #who-panel entirely, so phone users had no
way to see channel members. Add a "here" button to the chat header that
toggles the existing panel as a right-edge drawer on mobile; desktop
keeps the always-visible sidebar. Escape closes the drawer.

Add e2e screenshots for the mobile who drawer

Captures the new "N here" header button in its resting state and the
slide-in drawer fully open, at the phone viewport, so the new UI can be
eyeballed alongside the rest of the screenshot set.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01Kvg7m5hacw7tYqUVSv52R6

ended.reason: Merged by john as 3ebd17d ('Add mobile who-panel drawer with toggle button'), 2 min after the last commit; no PR review text in the material.
906b8ea (change-16 head) adds the here toggle and drawer; see decision-18.

fields.says: The mobile media query hid #who-panel entirely, so phone users had no way to see channel members.

fields.answer: On mobile the who panel is a right-edge slide-in drawer inside .chat-body (not covering header or input row), toggled by an "N here" header button with aria-expanded; desktop keeps the always-visible sidebar; Escape closes the drawer; leaving closes it and resets the count.
fields.why: Reuses the existing panel instead of hiding it (906b8ea).

fields.what: Eyeball 10-chat-mobile-who-closed.png and 11-chat-mobile-who-open.png (390x844, dark) alongside the rest of the screenshot set.
fields.why-person: The spec only waits for the count and the open transform; whether the drawer and the N here button look right is a visual call.
fields.how: Run the e2e screenshot spec; the images are not committed.
